_comment: Canonical VPS daemon HTTP contract fixture, pinned byte-for-byte between two repos. Source of truth: toolu-ghrunner's crates/daemon/tests/fixtures/vps-daemon-contract.json, asserted against the real routes/wire.rs types by crates/daemon/src/tests/fixture.rs. Vendored copy: toolu.sh's packages/api/src/__tests__/fixtures/vps-daemon-contract.json, asserted against the real providers/vps/client.ts by __tests__/vps-contract-fixture.test.ts. Both copies must stay byte-identical; each repo records this file's SHA-256 in the sibling vps-daemon-contract.sha256 and fails its own suite if the copy it holds no longer matches. Edit only the source-of-truth copy, then re-copy verbatim and update both recorded hashes.
